mentions.name: boot.dev
mentions.description: This is an online education platform for programmers that offers interactive coding courses. Current work includes an in-browser update of its Kubernetes (k8s) course, a new C course, and Terraform and Bash courses in development.
mentions.problem: Keeping the platform alive and viable amidst a wave of AI doomerism about the value of being good at things.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just trying to keep https://www.boot.dev alive and kicking amidst this wave of AI doomerism surrounding... The value of being good at things.

Working on an in-browser update of our k8s course, a new C course, as well as terraform and bash courses coming down the pipe.

mentions.name: Boot.dev backend learning path (TypeScript)
mentions.description: This is Boot.dev's backend development learning path, now ported to TypeScript so learners can complete it in Python/TypeScript in addition to the previously available Python/Go tracks. Official release is set for Cinco de Mayo.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just finished porting Boot.dev's backend learning path to TypeScript (used to only be available in Python/Go, now also Python/TS)
